name: chad-review
description: Strip the showing-off from any artifact by making it survive Chad — its intended audience with the meme personality, impossible to impress. Chad leaves dumb honest feedback comments (bird's-eye included), a defender who treats him as an asset fixes or rejects each with a reason, and the same Chad re-reviews round after round (default 3); unresolved tensions go to the human. Ships a reusable workflow + an accompanying skill.
